selection_contract.candidate_discovery: Use upstream divisions only to narrow the catalog. Match the approved task against the evidence-backed source description before selecting an Agent.
selection_contract.automatic_selection: Allowed only for an Agent whose metadata has auto_route: true, where the task supplies a scenario query and the dispatch has a live connected transport.
selection_contract.explicit_selection: A planner may select any evidence-backed Agent by external_agent_id in an approved task. Manual-only entries remain usable through this explicit selector.
prohibitions: Do not infer a capability from an Agent name alone.
Do not use division membership as proof of a specific capability.
Do not allow an external Agent to approve work, resolve blockers, change scope, or replace independent review.
Do not auto-dispatch through a file queue or an adapter without a real connected worker session.

planning.role: Clarify the approved goal and plan contract; Agents provide bounded research or domain input only.

execution.role: Perform one exact approved task in an isolated worker session and return evidence.

review.role: Independently assess evidence against the exact acceptance criteria; no self-review.
